notes.title: Front Lines Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Bug fixes[/b]

- Fixed the final tutorial prompt from disappearing 
- Fixed an audio bug where the radio wouldn't change volume regardless of settings
- Fixed an audio bug where the explosive turret shot wouldn't change volume regardless of settings
- Fixed an issue where the upgrade menu would appear dark
- Fixed an issue where turrets would still recoil even without ammo
- Fixed an issue where repeatedly pressing pause would freeze the game
- Fixed an issue where the machine gun turret could not shoot the stationary weapons
- Various changes to level collisions to stop tanks getting stuck

[b]Additions and changes[/b]

- The player's tracks are now animated - work in progress
- Added roaming enemies to add to the action between objectives
- Added a dust trail behind enemy tanks 
- Added an audio indicator for when you are unable to switch turrets
- Visual adjustments to particle effects
- Visual adjustments to Operation: Snowfall

Stay tuned for bigger announcements on the horizon...
